mapper.select: SELECT id, channel, external_user_id, email, verification_method, verified_at, created_at, updated_at FROM bot_user_bindings WHERE channel = #{channel} AND lower(email) = lower(#{email})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bot_user_bindings ( channel, external_user_id, email, verification_method, verified_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{channel}, #{externalUserId}, #{email}, #{verificationMethod}, #{verifiedAt}, now(), now() ) ON CONFLICT (channel, external_user_id) DO UPDATE SET email = EXCLUDED.email, verification_method = EXCLUDED.verification_method, verified_at = EXCLUDED.verified_at, updated_at = now()
